With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

  • One team, One mission: Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
  • Own it: We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Accountable to our customers: We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
  • Excellence in execution: Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
  • Be bold, fail fast, learn faster: We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

The Role:

We are looking for a backend engineer to join our team responsible for the acquisition and renewal stages of the customer journey. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Stakeholders to increase conversion and maximize revenue while improving the experience our customers have as they trial our software, purchase, renew and manage their Nitro subscriptions.

What you’ll be doing:

You will join the existing team and collaborate on delivering feature, security, scalability and resiliency enhancements to our existing Scala code base. You will contribute to the design of new features and work cross-functionally with other Nitro Engineering teams to support the exciting enhancements coming to the Nitro cloud product suite.

What we’re looking for:

  • JVM-based development and deployment experience.
  • Strong knowledge of, and professional development experience with a JVM based language, preferably Scala.
  • Experience building SaaS products, particularly in the AWS cloud.
  • Knowledge of event-driven concepts and architectures.
  • Familiarity with continuous development and deployment practices.
  • Ability to drive project delivery from early ideation through to production deployment.
  • Commitment to software quality through clean code, testing and verification.
  • Open and transparent communicator as comfortable with in-person collaboration as with solo focus.

Why Nitro?

Along with our regular benefits and programs (including health, dental, vision, and retirement as standard), we are also very proud to offer a few additional initiatives to future Nitronauts:

Hybrid Work: Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

Benefits: Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We provide an accessible candidate experience and invite you to request any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond.

description:
Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com 2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Sénior, Analista Probabilisto de Seguridad(PSA)

¿Estás buscando una empresa que trabaje en grandes proyectos de ingeniería en todo el mundo? ¿Quieres marcar la diferencia mejorando la vida diaria de las comunidades a nivel mundial? ¿Buscas unirte a un equipo inclusivo y diverso en el que realmente puedas confiar? ¡Has llegado al lugar correcto! Únete a nosotros para remodelar el futuro con AtkinsRéalis. AtkinsRéalis está dedicada a diseñar un futuro mejor para nuestro planeta y su gente.

AtkinsRéalis es uno de los grupos de ingeniería nuclear del sector privado más grandes de Canadá. Hemos estado proporcionando una amplia gama de servicios a la industria nuclear en Canadá y en todo el mundo durante más de 60 años. Estamos orgullosos de ser los guardianes de la tecnología nuclear CANDU canadiense.

AtkinsRéalis está buscando Analistas de Seguridad PSA para ser parte de nuestro equipo en el apoyo al diseño de nuevas plantas de energía nuclear y la operación y renovación de las plantas de energía nuclear CANDU existentes. El analista senior de PSA trabajará con otros miembros junior y senior del personal para desarrollar y aplicar metodologías de análisis avanzadas para realizar PSAs y otros análisis de seguridad relacionados con PSA para plantas existentes, en renovación y nuevas construcciones. Estos incluyen temas relacionados con la identificación de peligros, PSA de Nivel 1, PSA de Nivel 2, PSA de Nivel 3, evaluaciones de seguridad sísmica, de inundación y/o de incendio, análisis de modos de falla y efectos, eventos internos y externos. También se espera que los candidatos puedan desarrollar material de capacitación en PSA y revisar documentos de PSA.

Ubicación – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Tu rol dentro del equipo:

Se espera que los candidatos tengan fuertes habilidades analíticas y técnicas en PSA y estén listos para asumir varias tareas técnicas en un corto período de tiempo. Esto incluye, pero no se limita a:

  • Responsable de las evaluaciones de seguridad probabilística de los sistemas de planta, especialmente en el área de eventos internos, apagado, incendio interno, inundación interna y eventos sísmicos, así como otros peligros externos.
  • Responsable de realizar evaluaciones de sistemas de confiabilidad (proceso y seguridad), especialmente sistemas de seguridad, por ejemplo, enfriamiento de emergencia del núcleo, contención, etc.), balance de planta (BOP) y sistemas relacionados con la operación y seguridad de la planta.
  • Interactuar con clientes/proyectos para evaluar problemas operativos y de seguridad y asesorar sobre posibles soluciones.
  • Preparar y/o revisar propuestas de trabajo para clientes internos y externos.
  • Desarrollar monitores de riesgo y evaluaciones de generación de riesgo.
  • Conocimiento de metodologías, códigos y estándares de PSA (por ejemplo, canadiense, estadounidense, IAEA).
  • Desarrollar, planificar, programar, realizar o coordinar fases detalladas del trabajo de análisis para un proyecto de gran alcance.
  • Proponer/desarrollar enfoques a utilizar en tareas de análisis de seguridad.
  • Coordinar el trabajo con todas las interfaces, incluyendo la gestión de proyectos, así como un equipo de análisis multidisciplinario.
  • Supervisar el trabajo del personal en un entorno multidisciplinario y ser responsable de la calidad del trabajo realizado.
  • Proporcionar orientación técnica y liderazgo a ingenieros de niveles inferiores y/o a otros empleados técnicos.
  • Proporcionar refuerzo positivo y actuar proactivamente para fomentar relaciones positivas y trabajo en equipo.
  • Asegurar que el trabajo se realice de manera consistente con los requisitos del proyecto.

¿Por qué elegir AtkinsRéalis como empleador? Porque ofrecemos:

  • Un entorno emocionante donde el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida personal es importante.
  • Una amplia gama de oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.
  • Pago competitivo y beneficios flexibles.
  • Un entorno de trabajo enfocado en la salud y la seguridad.

El candidato ideal:

  • Un título relevante con honores de una universidad de reconocido prestigio en Ingeniería con 10+ años de experiencia relevante.
  • Excelente conocimiento del diseño CANDU, incluyendo tanto NSP (especialmente sistemas de seguridad) como BOP.
  • Amplio conocimiento del funcionamiento del sistema, la respuesta de la planta y la comprensión de los principios de confiabilidad subyacentes.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de cerca y de manera efectiva con los clientes en una relación cliente/consultor.
  • Capacidad para trabajar bien bajo presión y ser flexible, es decir, debe ser capaz de realizar asignaciones de trabajo variadas de manera efectiva y responder rápidamente a las necesidades cambiantes del proyecto.
  • Conocimiento del análisis de accidentes graves y las directrices de gestión de accidentes graves.
  • Habilidades de liderazgo comprobadas, proporcionando orientación técnica para asistir y supervisar a los analistas.
  • Capacidad para mostrar iniciativa mientras se trabaja en un entorno de equipo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con presupuesto y cronograma.
  • Debe estar dispuesto a viajar ocasionalmente para participar en recorridos, reuniones y talleres.
  • Compromiso total con el trabajo en un entorno de QA formal.
  • Ventajas: Competencia en la suite de códigos de computadora CAFTA, CFAST y RiskSpectrum. La experiencia en actividades de licencia, comprensión del diseño de reactores de agua ligera y PSAs.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en inglés.

¿Estás listo para este desafío? Aplica hoy y únete a nuestro equipo para ayudar a diseñar un mejor futuro para nuestro planeta y su gente. En AtkinsRéalis, buscamos contratar a personas con diversas características, antecedentes y perspectivas. Creemos firmemente que el talento de clase mundial no hace distinciones basadas en género, origen étnico o nacional, identidad y orientación sexual, edad, religión o discapacidad, sino que se enriquece a través de estas diferencias.

title: Senior Portfolio Analyst
description:
• Business Units: MG - International Markets

Company Description

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Job Description

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, and support and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As part of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support the Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;

  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais, de execução e negociação.
  • Habilidades interpessoais para trabalhar efetivamente em equipe e influenciar todos os níveis.
  • Disposição para liderar mudanças e apoiar uma organização de classe mundial.

Na PepsiCo, promovemos uma equipe diversa, colaborativa, equitativa e inclusiva, com oportunidades iguais para todos, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

description:

Join to apply for the Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.
Location : we have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.
What you will focus on

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • You have worked on open source virt or container tech
  • You have experience working in the kernel or very low level system
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  3. Automação de Infraestrutura (infra as a code): Habilidade em desenvolver scripts (Shell, Ruby, Python, Go) e ferramentas de automação para provisionamento e gerenciamento de recursos na nuvem, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, Chef ou Puppet;
  4. Gestão de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Capacidade de otimizar custos em nuvem através da implementação de práticas de FinOps, monitorando e controlando os gastos na GCP;

Seria um diferencial:

  2. Machine Learning e IA Generativa: Conhecimento básico em conceitos de machine learning e inteligência artificial generativa, utilizando bibliotecas como TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.

title: Account Consultant, Dive & Rescue
description:
We’re seeking an Account Consultant to join our newly established Dive & Rescue team, spearheading strategic interactions with unmanaged at-risk of attrition sellers through customized 90-day account management plans. This role combines hands-on seller interaction and in-depth performance and status analysis to develop and implement personalized seller support, with room for conducting systematic solutions that address recurring challenges. Overall, aiming to enhance marketplace retention. As a pioneering member of this team, you’ll have the opportunity to participate on shaping the team’s direction. The ideal candidate will bring a dynamic blend of relationship management expertise & analytical thinking. Goal is for you to drive initiatives that deliver measurable impact on seller success while contributing to the foundation of a new unit.
Key job responsibilities
Analysis & Direct Seller Engagement:
- Analyze root causes and conditions leading to sellers' unmanaged, at-risk, or post-attrition status
- Build and maintain seller relationships through multi-channel communication (phone, email, etc.) with consistent check-ins
- Research and understand seller cohort characteristics, including trends, seasonality, and competitive dynamics to provide targeted guidance
- Gather and analyze seller feedback regarding status, needs, and challenges to develop both personalized and scalable solutions
- Discover and make use of available tools and resources to conduct comprehensive seller profile analysis prior to engagement
Performance Management:
- Diagnose critical performance issues and develop collaborative action plans
- Manage and prioritize seller pipeline effectively to achieve targeted outcomes
- Guide sellers to proficiency with Amazon's tools and programs, promoting self-sufficiency and adherence to marketplace standards
Program & Process Improvement:
- Contribute to implementing efficient SOPs for knowledge sharing within the new Dive & Rescue team
- Identify and document attrition patterns, best practices, and improvement opportunities
- Create and implement preventive programs that address common challenges with scalable solutions
- Partner with internal teams to leverage available resources while advocating for seller needs
Analytics & Reporting:
- Track and analyze performance metrics for both individual sellers and programmatic initiatives
- Monitor and report on seller recovery KPIs and intervention effectiveness
A day in the life
- Review dashboards and reports to check Seller performance metrics
- Research seller profiles and prioritize pipeline
- Prepare talking points for upcoming engagements
- Conduct scheduled and proactive seller calls/meetings
- Respond to urgent seller communications via email
- Send follow-up emails with agreed action items
- Document call outcomes and update action plans
- Update tracking tools with latest interactions and status
- Perform deep-dive analysis of specific seller cases
- Analyze patterns from recent seller interactions
- Document newly discovered issues for potential solutions
- Review aggregated seller feedback to identify common pain points
- Map processes and identify optimization opportunities
- Engage with internal stakeholders to foster and initiate programmatic solutions
About the team
The Dive & Rescue team is a new unit dedicated to supporting unmanaged sellers whose performance indicates they may need additional guidance or are at risk of underperforming and leaving the marketplace. We combine data-driven insights with personalized support to help sellers and tackle attrition by:
- Providing targeted interventions through 90-day management plans that could help sellers recover
- Developing systematic solutions that address recurring challenges
Our team culture embraces:
- Creative problem-solving: We're building our playbook and welcome fresh perspectives
- Data-driven decisions: We combine analytical rigor towards practical business insights
- Collaborative spirit: We work closely with sellers, cross-functional teams and among ourselves
- Continuous learning: Every seller interaction and research is an opportunity to gather meaningful insights
- Proactive mindset: We want to become able to address potential issues before they become critical
We are committed to the process of relentlessly focusing on quality execution to strengthen marketplace retention.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
- More than 2+ year of experience in account management, customer success, or related customer-facing roles
- Basic analytical skills and proficiency with Excel
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach
- Experience working with business metrics and data analysis
- Knowledge of e-commerce of marketplace environments
- Basic understanding of SQL
- Experience of being at cross-functional teams

title: Advogado Criminalista - Escritório Sandro de Abreu Santos
description:
A missão de um advogado criminalista é ser um defensor atualizado e dedicado aos clientes, sempre agindo dentro dos limites da lei e respeitando os mais altos padrões éticos da advocacia.

1. Atuação Judicial:

  • Propor Ações: Atuar em processos judiciais, como ações de cobrança, indenização por danos, dissolução de sociedade, revisão de contratos, entre outras.
  • Defender em Ações: Defender clientes em processos judiciais, incluir contrarrazões, defender recursos, elaborar petições iniciais e acompanhar processualmente.
  • Executar Sentenças: Auxiliar na execução de sentenças judiciais, como cobrar dívidas ou cumprir decisões de natureza alimentar, familiar ou contratual.
  • Atuar em Ações Cautelares: Em situações urgentes, atuar em medidas cautelares, como requerer tutela antecipada, arresto ou sequestro de bens, para assegurar o resultado de um processo.
  • Acompanhar Litígios: Representar o cliente em audiências de conciliação, instrução e julgamento, além de elaborar estratégias jurídicas para o andamento dos processos.

2. Atuação Extrajudicial:

- Prestar Consultoria Jurídica: Orientar preventivamente sobre direitos e deveres do cliente, visar evitar litígios e prevenir problemas legais.

  • Negociar Acordos: Mediar e negociar entre as partes envolvidas em um conflito, buscar soluções amigáveis para evitar o processo judicial. Aplicar em questões de família, contratos, disputas entre empresas, entre outras.
  • Elaborar e Revisar Contratos: Redigir contratos de compra e venda, prestação de serviços, locação, sociedades, acordos comerciais etc., assegurar que as cláusulas estejam conforme a legislação e protejam os interesses das partes envolvidas.
  • Formalizar Acordos: Elaborar termos de acordo, escrituras públicas, distratos, ajustes entre partes, visar formalizar soluções extrajudiciais e evitar litígios.
  • Atuar em Acordos de Mediação e Arbitragem: Caso as partes optem por soluções alternativas de resolução de disputas, atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem.

3. Redação de Documentos:

- Elaborar Contratos: Elaborar e revisar contratos de diferentes naturezas, como comerciais, de prestação de serviços, de parceria, entre outros.

  • Redigir Testamentos e Escrituras Públicas: Elaborar testamentos, escrituras públicas de compra e venda, doações, entre outros documentos legais.
  • Elaborar Notificações e Petições: Redigir notificações extrajudiciais, petições e solicitações diversas, como notificações de inadimplência ou de cobrança.
  • Preparar Distratos e Aditivos Contratuais: Elaborar documentos que formalizam a alteração ou rescisão de contratos existentes.

4. Negociações e Resolução de Conflitos:

- Negociar Dívidas e Condições de Pagamento: Intermediar negociações de dívidas, propor acordos que facilitem o pagamento e evitem ações judiciais.

  • Resolver Disputas de Propriedade: Negociar acordos entre as partes envolvidas em disputas de posse ou propriedade, como acordos de condomínio ou regularização de imóveis.
  • Mediar Acordos de Família: Em questões familiares (como divórcios e partilhas), atuar na negociação de acordos amigáveis, sem a necessidade de litígio judicial.
  • Participar em Mediação e Arbitragem: Atuar em processos de mediação e arbitragem, métodos alternativos para resolução de conflitos sem recorrer ao judiciário.

5. Assessoria e Planejamento:

- Planejar Patrimônio: Prestar consultoria na organização e planejamento de patrimônio, como planejar sucessão e gerir bens em vida.

  • Assessorar sobre Direitos de Consumo e Empresas: Orientar sobre as melhores práticas e direitos relacionados ao consumidor e às relações empresariais, prevenir conflitos e ações judiciais.
  • Orientar sobre Responsabilidade Civil: Assessorar sobre situações de risco à responsabilidade civil, como acidentes, danos causados a terceiros e outras implicações legais.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Esta iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Coordenador Operacional atuará no monitoramento e análise de dados do projeto, apoiando na elaboração de relatórios periódicos de desempenho das metas e demais atividades administrativas do projeto. Além disso, ficará responsável pela coordenação da equipe operacional e relacionamento com o cliente.

  6. Selecionar e contratar todos os colaboradores necessários para realização das atividades e dos eventos, cumprindo as diretrizes organizacionais e as especificações do projeto;
  7. Coordenar os processos administrativos para aquisições de materiais, contratação de serviços e gestão de pessoas zelando pela correta aplicação dos procedimentos administrativos da AVSI Brasil, e em conformidade ao Plano de Aquisições do projeto;

Primary Interface between Markets/Sales, Strategic Product Management, and Operations for ASU products:

  • Primary day-to-day interface with account managers and regional Markets leadership on understanding changes in customer demand that will affect supply network configuration.
  • Provide product availability and costing analyses to Strategic Product Management for over DOA-based new business and investment case analyses and senior management for overall business management.
  • Executes ASU energy and diesel surcharge policy defined by Strategic Product Management and Markets based on major cost changes within the network.
  • Support Tonnage account managers on liquid back-up or supplemental concerns (volume availability and costing).

Tactical Supply Chain Planning and Optimization:

  • Assigns plant production rates, operating modes and inventory targets in collaboration with Remote Operating Center engineers and Energy Procurement team to minimize overall product costs. This includes day-of plant turndowns/shutdowns to meet power reduction obligations and minimize/avoid peak power costs.
  • Responsible for coordinating with scheduling teams on inventory vs alternate sourcing needs to minimize impact to customers.
  • Ensures all mid- and long-term purchase agreements are utilized based on lowest total incremental costs.
  • Responsible for development, use and compliance to proprietary network optimization systems (TACT), including quality of inputs and adherence to outputs.
  • Execute supply reviews with Supply field regions and develop operational plans for Sales and Operations Planning. Sets transport resource levels required to fulfill plan while minimizing assets and costs.

Operative Supply Chain Response:

  • Responsible for ensuring sufficient inventory for all pipeline demand (gaseous) and internal plant uses through inventory planning via plant mode changes, liquid product transfers between storage tanks, liquid imports (as required) and/or coordinating deliveries from third parties.
  • Plan, track and own the outage process for ASU. Includes developing plans, forecasting and tracking costs, and providing timely communication on the status of the network during planned and unplanned outages.

Systems Usage & Maintenance:

  • Parcview, J5, Telemetry
  • TACT, Optimizer and potential new, future network optimization tools
  • Sales and Operations Planning including Demand Planning tools
  • SAP and GOLD
  • SAP Analytics Cloud for data visualization

  • Responsible for developing key operational assumptions and associated costs for the annual budgeting process and ongoing reforecasts, including purchases, rail shipments, planned outage (dislocation) costs.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 7 years experience in industrial gases or related process industry with supply chain management experience.
  • C.P., M.B.A. and six sigma certifications are a plus.

Required key skills:

  • Strong strategic and tactical thinking are required to analyze and manage a dynamic national network.
  • Must have strong Microsoft Office skills, especially in Excel, Power Point and Word.

description:
Join to apply for the Radiologic Technologist $2000 Bonus role at Concentra

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Overview

Up to $2000 Bonus

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Radiologic Technologist & Medical Support Specialist performs routine x-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations under direct supervision of the treating clinician, as well as supports in other needed areas of the facility. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. The RT MSS ensures that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

Radiologic Technologist Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety, and comfort during the x-ray exam.
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety.
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members.
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director.
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports are correctly entered into EMR.
  • Follow documentation procedures and complete required documentation related to patient x-ray visits.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures.

Medical Assistant Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing.
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including vital signs and ancillary testing (vaccines, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiograms, respirator fit testing, etc.).
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.).
  • Assist providers during examinations and treatments.
  • Perform routine medical procedures as ordered, and triage emergent patients as needed.
  • Assist with procedure setup and injury care.
  • Apply bandages, dressings, and splints as ordered.
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered, in accordance with regulations.
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and devices.
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms, and operate all medical devices, including calibration and record keeping.
  • Notify supervisor of equipment issues or supply needs.
  • Assist with patient flow and volume management.
  • Keep patients informed of wait times.
  • Handle clerical tasks, including documentation, check-in/out, and communication.
  • Follow HIPAA and safety guidelines.
  • Attend staff meetings and maintain a clean, organized facility.
  • Complete ongoing training as required.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Graduate of an accredited radiologic technology program with applicable state certification.
  • Registered with ARRT with active certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification.

Experience and Skills

  • At least six months of medical assistant experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of occupational medicine requirements is a plus.
  • Service-oriented, detail-focused, with a sense of urgency, initiative, and flexibility.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information per HIPAA and PHI regulations.
  • Team player with good working relationships at all levels.
  • Ability to obtain necessary certifications, including drug screen and collection certifications.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Additional Benefits

  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Medical, vision, dental, telehealth coverage.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Paid time off and illness days.
  • Referral bonus, tuition reimbursement, commuter benefits, dependent care accounts, and employee discounts.

This role requires handling confidential information with discretion. Concentra is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities during the application and employment process.

Concentra is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.

Join to apply for the Planning and Scheduling Team Manager role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM - providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our customers globally. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include compressor loaded turbo-expanders, generator-loaded power recovery expanders, and low-cost dissipative expanders. We offer new equipment designs, rerates, upgrades and repair along with field services, engineering evaluations, reliability, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, shop services, and new equipment replacements for all types of centrifugal and reciprocating equipment. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
Gardner Cryogenics designs and manufactures high-performance, highly reliable, long-lasting storage tanks used to transport hydrogen and helium molecules around the globe. With more than six decades of experience, Gardner provides customers with industry-leading technology that enables them to cost-effectively move and store molecules with near zero loss. The unique technology developed by Gardner provides the lowest heat-leak for the highest yield when transporting, storing, and transferring helium and hydrogen.
We are seeking a results-oriented Planning and Scheduling Team Manager for our Gardner Cryogenics and Rotoflow manufacturing facilities, within the Lehigh Valley, PA. This position will be responsible for managing planning and scheduling team and overseeing the entire process from new order intake through delivery of contract, including aggregating information for resource planning, reporting of on-time delivery metrics, and helping to drive process improvements in the speed of execution, process efficiency and fulfilment of orders. This position interfaces closely with Sales and Proposals, Manufacturing, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure execution and manufacturing dates are being met. This position will be located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and will split time between the Rotoflow and Gardner facilities.
What's In It For You
At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)

  • Paid Vacation, holidays + sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)

  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Leading and developing the team of planners and schedulers across Gardner and Rotoflow,
  • Acting as a mentor, guide, and decision maker for the team to enable peak performance and remove barriers to progress,
  • Conducting performance evaluations and direct day-to-day management of team members,
  • Setting overarching goals, objectives, and development plans for the team and team members aligned with leadership cascaded goals,
  • Driving the team to efficiently and effectively plan and schedule activities aligned with Project Management milestones and delivery schedules,
  • Owning and driving enhancement and improving accuracy of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
  • Translating sales opportunity pipeline into workforce and facility demand and capacity planning and scheduling (S&OP),
  • Working closely with Sales and Proposals to anticipate order timing and align proposal schedules and deliveries with current workload, supplier loading and availability, and facility capacity to ensure appropriate customer deliveries are achievable,
  • Setting priorities, finding solutions, and collaborating with all disciplines within the business to enable the faithful execution of work,
  • Driving the optimization of plans and schedules based on inputs (part availability, resource availability, work center availability, etc.) to accommodate unplanned or unforeseen circumstances such as customer emergencies,
  • Developing a world class planning and scheduling work processes, systems, and tools to enable efficient and effective execution of all aspects of work aligned with the business growth goals,
  • Assessing and resolving limitations, gaps, constraints, bottlenecks, delays, and other unplanned barriers impacting engineering and manufacturing,
  • Leading production meetings,
  • Developing and owning key performance indicators for planning and scheduling and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred. Experience considered in lieu of a technical degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of planning and scheduling experience with discrete equipment manufacturing or similar.
  • Prior leadership experience leading a team of direct reports.
  • Exemplify a passion for winning and ability to motivate teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning module preferred.
  • Certifications such as PPM, APICS, ASM, or related are a strong plus.
  • Experience with MS Office Suite, (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook, PowerPoint) required.
  • Broad strategic thinker, with a clear vision and direction to improve business performance.
  • Proven track record for planning and scheduling process improvement and results.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. Identify and recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
  • Detail, goal, and results oriented, organized, creative, self-motivated, collaborative, and customer focused.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills (written, verbal and presentation).
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, conflict management, performance management, data driven and analytical approach.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and collaboratively with engineers, technicians, and suppliers in shop, office, and field environments.
  • High energy, desire to learn new skills, and desire to understand the specifics of the processes and inter-related steps that are required to fulfil a variety of orders, from design, engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
  • Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.

Job description

QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano! Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética.

Main responsibilities

DADOS:

GS 17

Local: Norte

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responder pela Ex-Mill, Margem de Contribuição, Volume, Faturamento, Distribuição Numérica e Ponderada - dentre outros indicadores de sua região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela companhia;
  • Atuar de acordo com a Rotina de Trabalho Suzano estabelecida para os clientes/canais de atendimento Direto ou Indireto;
  • Garantir a execução SUZANO no PDV (Loja Perfeita) - Mix Mínimo, Planograma, Precificação, Qualidade, Exposição e presença de Material de PDV;
  • Presença no Mercado (área sob sua responsabilidade) de acordo com a definição do Processo de Vendas;
  • Aplicar a política comercial Suzano de acordo com a estratégia para a região, canal ou cliente sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua do resultado de seus clientes;
  • Estabelecer Planos de Negócios – JBP, para as contas/clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas e clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Realizar o planejamento colaborativo de Demanda de produtos;
  • Prospectar clientes com potencial e que estejam dentro do perfil de produtos SUZANO;
  • Explorar detalhadamente cada ponto da sua verba off-invoice;
  • Atuar e monitorar o Sell Out nos seus clientes;
  • Avaliar seu próprio desempenho e propor-se um plano de melhoria operacional continuamente;
  • Ter domínio sobre condições comerciais expressas nos contratos realizados com os clientes de sua carteira.

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Conhecer do mercado e clientes de bens de consumo do mercado/da região;
  • Ter conhecimento dos clientes e varejistas da região de atuação;
  • Ser dinâmico, comunicativo, negociador, proativo, resiliente e com foco em resultados.

Additional information

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas famílias, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

Participar do #GrupoDeCorridaSuzano, um projeto pensado para manter a sua saúde em dia;

Receber atendimento nutricional;

Praticar ginástica laboral;

Usar o Gympass na academia de sua preferência;

title: ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DE PROCESSOS
description:
Responsabilidades do Cargo:

  • Conduzir estudos de HAZOP de forma independente, liderando sessões com times multidisciplinares e garantindo aderência às metodologias aplicáveis;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos técnicos de segurança de processos, incluindo análises de riscos, listas de ações, planos de mitigação, entre outros;
  • Participar de projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, atuando com: Definição e análise de redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers, detectores, etc.);
  • Estudo e definição de rotas de fuga e saídas de emergência;
  • Projetos de sistemas de detecção e combate a incêndio;
  • Avaliação de layouts quanto à conformidade com normas de segurança;
  • Apoiar projetos multidisciplinares da SANDECH, contribuindo tecnicamente com outras áreas conforme a demanda dos projetos;
  • Realizar outras análises de risco como What-if, LOPA, FMEA, HAZID, sempre que necessário;
  • Interagir com clientes e stakeholders, apresentando resultados técnicos com clareza e propondo soluções aderentes à realidade operacional;
  • Assegurar conformidade com normas e legislações, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API, IEC 61511, entre outras;
  • Acompanhar a implementação de recomendações de segurança, garantindo rastreabilidade e comunicação eficiente entre as partes envolvidas;
  • Contribuir com a melhoria contínua de processos internos, apoiando a evolução técnica das metodologias e padrões da SANDECH.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (Química, Processos, Mecânica, Civil, Produção ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada na condução de estudos de HAZOP como líder/facilitador, com autonomia técnica;
  • Conhecimento prático em outras metodologias de análise de riscos, como What-if, FMEA, LOPA e HAZID;
  • Experiência com projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, incluindo: Redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers e detectores), rotas de fuga, saídas de emergência, sistemas de combate e detecção de incêndios;
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API e IEC 61511;
  • Boa comunicação técnica e postura para interação com clientes e times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em outras frentes técnicas da SANDECH, conforme demanda.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Segurança de Processos, Gerenciamento de Riscos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações técnicas específicas em HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA ou normas como NFPA, API, IEC 61511;
  • Experiência anterior em consultorias de engenharia ou empresas do setor industrial com foco em segurança de processos;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de análise de riscos, como PHA Pro, PHAWorks, BowTie XP, entre outros;
  • Conhecimentos de projetos multidisciplinares (ex: processos, instrumentação, automação, layout de plantas industriais);
  • Vivência com clientes de setores regulados, como óleo e gás, químico, petroquímico, papel e celulose, etc.;
  • Inglês técnico (leitura de normas e documentação);
  • Participação em auditorias ou inspeções regulatórias envolvendo segurança de processos ou industrial.

Certificações Obrigatórias:

  • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho – essencial para atuar com projetos de segurança industrial (exigência legal e técnica);
  • Curso de Facilitador de HAZOP – com carga horária adequada e reconhecimento por instituição especializada (ex: CCPS, TÜV, DNV, SGS, Bureau Veritas ou similar).

Certificações Desejáveis:

  • Certificação avançada em HAZOP, emitida por instituições como TÜV Rheinland, DNV ou CCPS (quando for além do curso básico);
  • Certificações em outras metodologias de análise de riscos, como: LOPA, FMEA, PHA, BowTieXP – para aplicação da metodologia Bow Tie em gerenciamento de barreiras;
  • Certificação NFPA – voltada para combate a incêndio e proteção contra riscos industriais;
  • Certificações em normas técnicas internacionais, como IEC 61511 (Sistemas Instrumentados de Segurança) ou ISA S84;
  • Treinamentos OSHA – voltados para segurança operacional e prevenção de acidentes em ambientes industriais;
  • Certificados complementares em primeiros socorros, combate a incêndio ou resposta a emergências, especialmente para contextos de plantas operacionais.

Ferramentas e Softwares obrigatórios:

  • Pacote Office;
  • AutoCAD;
  • Microsoft Visio ou similar.

Ferramentas e Softwares desejáveis:

  • PHAWorks ou PHA-Pro;
  • BowTieXP;
  • ABNT Catálogo Online, Target GEDWeb, NFPA Codes, OSHA ou plataformas similares.

description:
Sobre nós
A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Participar do planejamento e da arquitetura de aplicações web, definindo estrutura de pastas, padrões de componentes e fluxos de dados.
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, seguindo as melhores práticas de UI/UX.
  • Desenvolver componentes reutilizáveis em ReactJS e/ou Angular, garantindo alta performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST, tratando de forma eficiente requisições assíncronas, autenticação e tratamento de erros.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração que garantam robustez e confiabilidade ao código.
  • Conduzir code reviews e tutorias, promovendo qualidade de código e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com designers, back-end e demais times em ciclos de entrega ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em ReactJS e/ou Angular, com projetos entregues em produção.
  • Domínio de JavaScript (ES6+) , incluindo tópicos como promessas, async/await, módulos e closure.
  • HTML5 semântico e CSS3 , com entendimento aprofundado de flexbox, grid e responsividade.
  • Experiência com pré-processadores (SASS) ou bibliotecas de CSS-in-JS (styled-components).
  • Prática na integração de APIs REST : consumo, mapeamento de dados e otimização de requisições.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de projetos front-end, definição de padrões de código e organização de repositórios.
  • Experiência comprovada em code review e aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Habilidade em criar e manter testes unitários para componentes e serviços.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • TypeScript : tipagem estática, generics e uso em projetos complexos.
  • Ferramentas de testes como Jest e Testing Library , com cobertura de testes significativa.
  • Configuração e otimização de bundlers: Webpack , Vite ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Experiência com frameworks de design system (Storybook, Bit) ou bibliotecas de UI.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • – Transmitir ideias de forma objetiva, ouvir ativamente e dar/receber feedback construtivo.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe
  • – Compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar colegas em bloqueios e alinhar-se com diferentes áreas (design, back-end, QA).
  • Orientação a resultados
  • – Manter o foco em metas e prazos, equilibrando qualidade de código e entregas ágeis.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo
  • – Priorizar tarefas, estimar prazos de forma realista e garantir entregas dentro do planejado.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo
  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.
  • Resiliência e gestão de pressão
  • – Manter a calma sob prazos apertados, lidar bem com retrabalho e aprender com erros.
  • Empatia com o usuário final
  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

title: Senior ML Backend Engineer
description:
Intuition Machines builds enterprise security products with an AI/ML focus. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.


What you will do:

  • Design, build, and maintain highly reliable backend systems that scale to millions of requests per second (RPS).
  • Translate business goals into technical specifications and iterative development plans. We ship early and often, and our first customer of a new product or feature may involve deploying it to 500 million users.
  • Work with queue-driven and event-driven designs, REST APIs, serverless and microservice architectures, and multi-cloud/multi-CDN environments using Kubernetes and other orchestrators.
  • Write Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (JS/TS) as necessary to meet business objectives.
  • Focus on producing clearly structured, maintainable, well-documented, and tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Collaborate with other backend developers to integrate your work with our infrastructure, including automating observability, deployment, quality, and security.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture & design sessions. Stay up-to-date with recent developments in relevant technologies and assess their applicability.
  • Take ownership of tasks that are not fully defined, proactively helping the team to shape and implement them.


What we are looking for:

  • Thoughtful, conscientious, and self-directed individuals.
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and maintaining large-scale production systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • In-depth knowledge of Python.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms (e.g., Argo, Kubernetes), containerization, and microservice design.
  • Experience with database systems (SQL, NoSQL), distributed systems and architectures, stream processing, test-driven development (TDD), and CI/CD.
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in a technical or related field from an accredited college or university, or equivalent job experience.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and presentation skills, with experience interacting with diverse audiences and mentoring peers.
  • Experience leading technical discussions with a team and driving decisions by balancing trade-offs.


Nice to Have:

  • College-level knowledge of mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, probability theory, statistics, matrix calculus).
  • Experience with Rust, Go, or other programming languages.
  • Ability to understand and write code in JavaScript/TypeScript (JS/TS).
  • Practical experience applying machine learning (ML) concepts, such as optimization, classification, regression, and generalization.


What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
  • Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all members of our team.

Join us as we transform cyber security, user privacy, and machine learning online!
